product_one_liner.value: Auterion provides an open, modular AI-powered autonomy software stack for governments and enterprises operating autonomous air, land, and sea platforms.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes AI-powered drone solutions and an open, modular autonomy stack powering air, land, and sea platforms for governments and enterprises. Source: https://auterion.com/auterion-introduces-nemyx-vertical-launch-system-for-drones-from-any-vendor

pricing_page.notes: The public Auterion Suite page includes subscription pricing, a Basic $0 plan, and a full pricing download. Source: https://auterion.com/enterprise/suite

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Auterion explicitly includes GE Aviation and Quantum-Systems in its global customer base, rather than merely identifying them as partners. Source: https://auterion.com/auterion-release-ai-node | named_customers.0: GE Aviation is explicitly named in Auterion's global customer base. | named_customers.1: Quantum-Systems is explicitly named in Auterion's global customer base.

employee_band.notes: Auterion's company profile explicitly reports 201–500 employees. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/auterion

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Auterion explicitly identifies Arlington, Virginia as its headquarters, corroborated by its US HQ address. Sources: https://auterion.com/company and https://auterion.com/auterion-raises-130-million-series-b-as-their-ai-enabled-software-powering-low-cost-commercial-hardware-at-scale-transforms-warfare | hq_country: The company identifies Arlington, Virginia as its headquarters and labels its Arlington address US HQ. Sources: https://auterion.com/company and https://auterion.com/auterion-raises-130-million-series-b-as-their-ai-enabled-software-powering-low-cost-commercial-hardware-at-scale-transforms-warfare

founded_year.notes: Auterion's company profile explicitly lists Founded 2017. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/auterion

eng_blog.notes: Two substantive engineer-authored posts qualify: Kamil Ritz, Computer Vision Engineer, explains visual positioning and VIO integration; Tanja Bauman, Software Engineer, and Julian Kent, Autonomy Lead, explain collision-prevention algorithms and testing. Sources: https://auterion.com/enabling_uav_navigation_in_environments_with_limited_or_no_gps_signal and https://auterion.com/making_autonomous_uav_missions_smarter/

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal contains multiple sections covering Suite and Mission Control, application development, and hardware integration. Its Getting Started article explicitly guides developers through developing, deploying, and integrating applications. Sources: https://docs.auterion.com/ and https://docs.auterion.com/app-development/app-development

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Computer Vision Engineer posting describes building onboard perception systems and also appears on the current job board. Sources: https://auterion.com/company/careers-open-position/8926308002?gh_jid=8926308002 and https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/auterion/jobs/8926308002

model_provider.notes: Auterion names Spleenlab's machine-learning solutions and states that VISIONAIRY AI software can be deployed on Skynode and AI Node. This is a disclosed supported integration, not a claim that every deployment uses it. Sources: https://auterion.com/product/skynode/spleenlabs-modular-visonairy-perception-software and https://auterion.com/ai-running-onboard-drones

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Auterion's August 2026 terms expressly state that the parties comply with applicable data-protection laws, including GDPR. This supports a GDPR compliance claim, not an independently accredited certification. No other requested certification was established. Source: https://auterion.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/20260801_AuterionGmbH_AGB_Final.pdf | compliance_certs.0: The terms explicitly name GDPR in their compliance commitment; this is not evidence of independent certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest identified funding announcement explicitly labels the round Series B. Source: https://auterion.com/auterion-raises-130-million-series-b-as-their-ai-enabled-software-powering-low-cost-commercial-hardware-at-scale-transforms-warfare | funding_date: The latest identified Series B announcement is dated September 23, 2025, yielding the requested month 2025-09. Source: https://auterion.com/auterion-raises-130-million-series-b-as-their-ai-enabled-software-powering-low-cost-commercial-hardware-at-scale-transforms-warfare | funding_amount_usd: The latest identified round announcement states that Auterion raised $130 million in Series B funding; this is the round amount, not cumulative funding. Source: https://auterion.com/auterion-raises-130-million-series-b-as-their-ai-enabled-software-powering-low-cost-commercial-hardware-at-scale-transforms-warfare

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2025 announcement confirms a $130 million Series B, within the eighteen months preceding November 9, 2026. Source: https://auterion.com/auterion-raises-130-million-series-b-as-their-ai-enabled-software-powering-low-cost-commercial-hardware-at-scale-transforms-warfare

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable board lists 25 openings, with no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or Account Executive title. Its Mission Coordinator, Solutions Engineer, and Product Marketing Specialist roles do not qualify. Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_board?for=auterion

launched_6mo.notes: The announcement titled 'Auterion Introduces Nemyx Vertical Launch System for Drones from Any Vendor' is dated October 5, 2026, within the six-month window. Source: https://auterion.com/auterion-introduces-nemyx-vertical-launch-system-for-drones-from-any-vendor

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership page was checked in full and showed no qualifying start within the window; no qualifying departure announcement was found. The identified COO and SVP appointments were announced in November 2024, outside the requested twelve months. Sources: https://auterion.com/company, https://auterion.com/auterion-announces-robert-rainhart-as-new-chief-operating-officer and https://auterion.com/auterion-welcomes-jan-hiesserich-as-svp-strategy

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Auterion's subprocessor statement lists HubSpot for customer fulfillment and marketing; an implementation case study also lists HubSpot among its systems. Sources: https://auterion.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/2023.04.04-Sub-processor-statement.pdf and https://www.caravel-partners.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Caravel_Win_Auterion.pdf | crm_stack_signal.0: The company lists HubSpot for customer fulfillment and marketing, corroborated by the implementation case study.
